## Definition of Done — Sprint-13

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

### All claude/producer-owned stories (S13-01..S13-09)
- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified per story file's Acceptance Criteria section
- [ ] No Logic/Integration test files required (sprint-13 has none such)
- [ ] No Visual-Feel evidence docs required (sprint-13 has none such)
- [ ] sprint-status.yaml row updated to status=done with changelog comment (200-byte hygiene)
- [ ] EPIC.md + index.md propagation per /story-done Phase 7 (codified S11-03; though sprint-13 stories don't graduate epics — N/A this sprint)
- [ ] Code reviewed (auto-pass for doc-only Config/Data stories; zero `.gd` code in sprint-13 plan)

### S13-02 + S13-10 USER-OWNED
- [ ] User attestation captured per refusal-to-fabricate posture (no claude write without explicit user input)
- [ ] **S13-02 §11 HARD GATE binding fulfilled** — disposition (a) user-attested OR (R1 fallback) (b) cancellation decision authored
- [ ] S13-10 attestation: PASS / FAIL records in qa-signoff doc

### Sprint-13 Close Gate (S13-03 dependency chain)
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` → `production/qa/smoke-sprint-13-[date].md` per S11-10 naming)
- [ ] QA sign-off report: APPROVED or APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS (run `/team-qa sprint-13-close` attestation-mode for closure-leaning)
- [ ] No S1 or S2 bugs in delivered features
- [ ] Sprint-13 retrospective authored at `production/retrospectives/retro-sprint-13-[date].md` (must address §11 first-binding outcome + closure-mode first-signal-evaluation outcome + 2 codification AIs delivered)
- [ ] **`/gate-check pre-prod-to-prod` re-run** (S13-03) — verdict documented; `production/stage.txt` written if PASS
